description:
Was this report useful? Rate an answer that came with `id_informe` (diagnosis, comparison, quick check...).
(¿Te ha servido? Valora un informe.)

Ask the user and pass their answer; never rate on their behalf. Nothing from the listing is stored.

Args:
    id_informe: the `id_informe` of the answer being rated.
    util: true if it was useful, false if not.
    comentario: optional comment from the user (up to 500 characters).
    lang: "es" (default) or "en".

Free and unlimited during the beta (until 2027-03-31). Gratis y sin límite durante la beta (hasta el 31-mar-2027).
name: wintraits_opinion
